verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or tenant-offboarding capability for Entra ID, and nothing about open export formats or migration away. The Graph user-list API (docs-11) is a developer building block, diagnostic-settings log routing (docs-9) is an adjacent retention feature covering only activity logs, and SCIM provisioning (docs-3, docs-4) is a related integration feature. None of these is a documented 'export everything and leave' capability, so they earn no credit.
